notFound.body: This record does not exist, or it is not one of yours.

errors.notFound: That company does not exist, or it is not one of yours.
errors.leadSourceNotSelectable: That lead source can only be set by someone who assigns leads.

errors.notFound: That contact does not exist, or it is not one of yours.

errors.atLeastOneCompany: A project needs at least one company.
errors.duplicateCompany: That company is already linked to this project.
errors.oneBuyerOnly: Only one company can be the buyer.
errors.lossReasonRequired: A lost project needs a reason.
errors.lastCompany: A project must keep at least one company.
errors.notFound: That project does not exist, or it is not one of yours.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.searchPlaceholder: Search by reference, project or company

detail.unpricedLines: Some lines have no price yet, so the totals below are incomplete.
detail.supersededBy: Superseded — version {number} is the live one.
detail.computed: Calculated by FACET from the lines.

actions.issueHint: Creates version {number} in FACET as issued. Type the number exactly as SMAC shows it.
actions.returnForEditHint: Sends it back to the rep. The version stays editable.
actions.acceptHint: Internal approval — the signatures are in. This is not the customer's commitment.
actions.reviseHint: Version {number} carrying the RE number. The lines are carried forward and the current version becomes read-only.
actions.extendHint: Use this when nothing has changed. Otherwise revise.
actions.confirmPaymentHint: The date the payment was received.

errors.notFound: That quotation does not exist, or it is not one of yours.
errors.projectNotVisible: You cannot raise a quotation on that project.
errors.companyNotOnProject: That company is not on this project. Add it to the project first, then come back.
errors.contactNotOnCompany: That contact does not belong to this company.
errors.colourChoice: Type a colour code, or a RAL / Pantone value.
errors.atLeastOneLine: A quotation needs at least one product line.
errors.lastLine: A quotation must keep at least one product line.
errors.versionNotEditable: This version has been issued. Create a revision to change it.
errors.alreadyIssued: This version already has a SMAC reference.
errors.coordinatorOnly: Only the sales coordinator can do that.
errors.noSuppliers: No product suppliers have been set up yet, so a line cannot be saved.

skeleton.heading: Project skeleton
skeleton.body: Schema and authentication are in place. Business screens arrive with the next phases.

detail.title: Dispatch
detail.creditsTargets: What actually went out. This is what credits a target.
detail.derivedHint: The company and the rep come from the quotation — they are not asked for.
detail.companySearchHint: You may search company names here. Opening the company record is a separate permission.
detail.directNotice: A direct sale has no quotation, so it is approved by the coordinator and is reported as a direct sale.
detail.linkedNotice: Dispatch against a quotation is only possible once payment has been confirmed.
detail.noneDispatchable: No quotation has a confirmed payment yet, so there is nothing to dispatch against.
detail.partialHint: One quotation can produce several partial dispatches. Quoted, paid and dispatched quantities are three different numbers.
detail.creditBySplit: Divided equally by the credit split in force since {date}.
detail.creditByRep: No credit split is in force, so the whole amount credits the rep on this dispatch.

errors.dispatchOnly: Only internal sales may record a dispatch.
errors.paymentNotConfirmed: Payment has not been confirmed on this quotation yet.
errors.companyNotOnThread: The company does not match the quotation.
errors.companyRequired: A direct sale needs a company.
errors.repRequired: A direct sale needs a rep.
errors.sqmPositive: Enter the square metres that actually went out.

detail.noSplit: No credit split. Each dispatch credits the rep named on it in full.

actions.setSplitHint: Choose who shares the credit. It divides equally, and it applies from the date below onward — earlier dispatches keep the credit they already have.

errors.creditSplitOnly: Only a sales manager or the sales coordinator may set a credit split.
errors.splitDuplicateUser: The same person was listed twice.
errors.splitNotBackdated: A credit split cannot be backdated — it would rewrite credit already given.
errors.userUnknown: One of the people chosen no longer exists.

targets.title: Targets
targets.empty: Nobody is measured for this month.

detail.derivedNotice: Achievement is derived from what was dispatched, and from nothing else. Targets are square metres only.
detail.activityPending: Activity is not recorded yet. When it is, it will be shown beside target progress — never combined with it into a single score.

errors.setTargetsOnly: Only a manager or an executive may set targets.
errors.userNotMeasurable: That person cannot carry a target.

fields.name: Name
fields.emailHint: This is the login identity. Changing it changes how the person signs in.
fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Set once, here — there is no reset screen.

detail.cannotSignIn: No password set — this account cannot sign in yet.
detail.targetsHint: Targets and achievement live on the targets screen, for everyone at once.
detail.handoverHint: Review everything this person still holds and pass it to a colleague.
detail.handoverClosed: Handover opens once the account is deactivated.

actions.deactivateHint: Access ends immediately and every open session is closed. The account is kept, never deleted.
actions.reactivateHint: The person can sign in again. No previous session is restored.

handover.title: Handover
handover.subtitle: Everything still held by {name}
handover.description: Nothing moves on its own. Tick what should change hands, choose who receives it, and every move is recorded.
handover.nothing: Nothing is left to hand over.
handover.reassignHint: A colleague who already holds a company keeps their single membership — nothing is duplicated.

errors.manageUsersOnly: Only a manager, an executive or a super admin may manage users.
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.emailTaken: That email already belongs to another user.
errors.roleUnknown: Choose a role from the list.
errors.nothingSelected: Choose at least one item to hand over.
errors.recipientIsSource: Choose somebody other than this person.
errors.recipientInactive: Work can only be handed to an active colleague.
errors.userStillActive: Deactivate the account before handing over their work.
errors.itemNotHeld: Something on this list has already moved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
